name: Nyalian Heritage Morning
shortDescription: Step into Nyalian's royal heritage — guided walk through Puri Agung Nyalian with Arja theatre excerpt.
description: Experience Nyalian's royal heritage at its source. This half-day cultural package takes you inside Puri Agung Nyalian, the historic royal residence remembered locally as a center of the West Klungkung Kingdom. A guided walk through the puri's historic architecture and courtyards reveals the founding story of Nyalian and the royal house's role in preserving Balinese culture. The highlight is a live Arja Gede Garong performance excerpt — Nyalian's signature folk theatre tradition, first staged here in the 1950s by Ida Tjokorda Gede Putra. This is the only place in Bali where you can learn the origin story of Arja directly at its birthplace. The package includes a small-group, guide-led storytelling format with traditional Balinese refreshments.

name: Sacred Waters Melukat Experience
shortDescription: A guided melukat purification ritual at Nyalian's sacred cliffside spring.
description: Find spiritual renewal at Pura Tirta Tadah Uwug, a sacred spring set into the eastern cliffside of the Tukad Melangit river valley. This half-day spiritual experience offers guided melukat (purification bathing) at a genuinely sacred, still-active spring — not a constructed spa experience. The site holds 10 spouts (pancoran) in total, with 9 used for melukat and 1 reserved for funerary rites. The upper 5 spouts are associated with the panca maha bhuta (five great elements), while the lower spouts are associated with bone, marrow, skin, and blood. Your guide or local pemangku leads you through the ritual, explaining the symbolic meaning and proper etiquette. After the ceremony, enjoy quiet reflection time by the river and refreshments at the on-site Tadah Uwuk Coffee and Eatery. Small-group and private options available for a more personal, contemplative pace.

name: Nyalian Full-Day Discovery
shortDescription: The complete Nyalian experience in a day — heritage, spirituality, and nature, with a home-cooked lunch.
description: The most complete single-day overview of Nyalian's three main Visitor Experience Pillars. This full-day immersive package combines royal heritage at Puri Agung Nyalian, spiritual purification at Pura Tirta Tadah Uwug, and nature immersion along the Tukad Melangit valley and rice terraces. Perfect for first-time visitors wanting a thorough introduction to the village, or travelers with limited time who want depth without a multi-day commitment. The package includes an authentic home-cooked lunch at a local family homestay, directly supporting village livelihoods. Good pacing ensures you experience the full spectrum of Nyalian's attractions while maintaining a contemplative, unhurried rhythm.

name: Tukad Melangit Trekking & Tirta Harum
shortDescription: Bali's most under-the-radar forest-temple trek — along the Tukad Melangit ravine to a hidden clan temple.
description: Trek through the Tukad Melangit river ravine to reach Pura Tirta Harum, a hidden forest temple on the boundary between Nyalian and neighboring Tamanbali. This half-day adventure offers Nyalian's most immersive nature-and-heritage combination — genuine physical activity paired with cultural depth. Pura Tirta Harum is a kawitan (clan-origin) temple of the Mahagotra Tirta Harum lineage, set inside forest terrain at the edge of the Tukad Melangit gorge. The temple is reachable only on foot, creating an adventurous, off-the-beaten-path experience. Your guide leads you through uneven forest and ravine terrain, with stops at scenic viewpoints. This package is recommended for active travelers, trekkers, and nature photographers comfortable with forest trekking. Small groups are preferred to preserve the site's quiet character.

name: Village Life & Craft Immersion
shortDescription: Weave your own capil hat alongside a local artisan family in Dusun Pemenang.
description: Experience Nyalian's living agricultural community and hereditary craft traditions in this half-day immersive package. Begin with a walking visit through the village's agricultural surroundings, observing everyday farming and animal husbandry activity that sustains most village households. Continue to Dusun Pemenang, where capil (traditional wide-brimmed coconut-leaf hat) weaving has been practiced for generations. Meet a local artisan who demonstrates the traditional weaving technique using janur (young coconut leaf). Then try your hand at basic capil-weaving steps under artisan guidance in a hands-on mini-workshop. Take home your finished capil hat as a meaningful, handmade souvenir. This package directly supports local UMKM (small enterprises) and offers genuine economic benefit to village craftspeople. Light traditional snack with the host family included.

name: Sacred Ceremony Witness (Seasonal, By Request)
shortDescription: Rare access to witness Tari Baris Tentara or Sang Hyang Jaran Mesiram — sacred rituals tied to ceremonial calendar.
description: This is not a scheduled show. It is a standing arrangement: if your travel dates happen to align with either the Napak Pertiwi procession (when Tari Baris Tentara is performed at Puri Agung Nyalian's Pamerajan Agung) or a Piodalan at Pura Kahyangan Desa Nyalian (when Sang Hyang Jaran Mesiram may occur), and community/temple permission allows, registered visitors may be given the opportunity to respectfully observe from an appropriate distance. Both events are sacred, trance-based, and pingit (restricted) in nature. Your guide provides real-time explanation of the ritual's meaning, helping you understand what you're witnessing rather than simply watching. Photography and video may be limited or prohibited depending on the occasion. This package cannot guarantee that any ceremony will occur during a given stay — it requires advance registration (minimum 2-4 weeks recommended) so the village/puri can confirm whether an upcoming ceremony is appropriate for visitor observation. This rare-access experience directly reinforces Nyalian's tourism philosophy of living culture over performance.
capacity: Small groups strongly preferred (5–8 persons max)

name: Nyalian Immersive Stay — 2 Days 1 Night
shortDescription: Stay the night with a Nyalian host family and live the village's four pillars firsthand.
description: The only package that includes an overnight homestay, generating direct income for a village family. This two-day, one-night immersive experience covers all four Visitor Experience Pillars in a single itinerary: royal heritage at Puri Agung Nyalian with Arja excerpt, spiritual purification at Pura Tirta Tadah Uwug, nature immersion along rice terraces and valley, and hands-on craft workshop with local artisan. Stay with a local homestay family, sharing home-cooked meals and informal storytelling that reveals everyday village life beyond what a day-tour can offer. Best option for travelers seeking deep immersion, honeymooners wanting an authentic detour from Bali's beach areas, and slow-travel enthusiasts. This is not just touring the village — it's experiencing village life firsthand.
